The late arrival with phone flash light being disturbing is such a common persona now. I saw The Odyssey at Lincoln Square Imax recently and it's exactly what happened with the person next to me. First they are 20 minutes late. Then they get confused as they don't recognize what's on the screen, talk loudly with each other trying to figure it out then at full volume asks me if they're in the right room. I tell them yes and ask them to be quiet. A few minutes later they turn on their phone with flash light. I ask them to shut that shit off. They do but not immediately as they fumble with their phone to finish texting That happened (minus the flashlight) another 5+ times throughout the movie. Repeatedly asking them to stop, they just nod but ignore it. Unfortunately to go tell a husher Id have to not only miss part of the movie, but there's not a lot of room to move in those seats and the offenders have tons of bags on the floor so I'd have to ask them to let me through which is easier said than done. Pain in the fucking ass. It's easier at Alamo, but that went downhill and it's very hit or miss if the staff will do anything.
